name: Loudoun Water Reclaimed Water Program
update_frequency: Updated as program requirements and service conditions change
known_limitations: The program describes reclaimed-water availability, hydraulic limits, allocation, and permitting discretion. It does not establish an allocation, connection, delivered volume, cooling performance, or potable-water displacement for a named data center.
automation_notes: Follow named allocation, capacity, construction-permit, connection, metering, and consumption records.
